name: PickleMyPaddle local pickup service area
description: NSW suburbs (localities) inside the PickleMyPaddle local pickup and drop-off area. Clubs whose venue is in one of these suburbs default to local pickup/drop-off; all others default to postal.
source: Suburb boundaries: NSW localities (PSMA via data.gov.au, tonywr71/GeoJson-Data). Postcodes: same repo, may be incomplete.
